sozlesmeler.aciklama: Contracts from templates, simple electronic signature via link, signed PDF and end-date reminders.

uzman_asistanlar.aciklama: Chat in your panel with AI assistants specialised in SEO, advertising, social media, branding and more.

raporlar.aciklama: Monthly service reports for your subscriptions.

sitem.aciklama: Grant or revoke maintenance access to your site and see the work log.

site_analizi.aciklama: SEO, speed, security and accessibility scores for your site with priority fixes.

islem.aciklama: Items waiting for your decision, such as quote acceptance and delivery approval.

denetim.aciklama: Recent changes made to your account and records.

bildirimler.aciklama: Choose which channel notifies you about each event.

profil.aciklama: Your contact details and account settings.

dosyalar.aciklama: Secure sharing for project files, folder permissions and documents we request from you.

uptime.aciklama: Minute-by-minute availability monitoring, downtime alerts and a public status page.

aylik_rapor.aciklama: An automatic monthly PDF bringing together SEO, analytics, speed and completed work.

whatsapp.aciklama: A team inbox on the official WhatsApp Business API, with assignment and quick replies.

talepler.aciklama: Messages from the site's forms and discovery briefs.

icerik.aciklama: Blog posts and the social media content plan.

pazaryeri.aciklama: Ready-made products and templates sold on the site.

analitik.aciklama: Visits, sources and conversions for the agency site.

fiyatlandirma.aciklama: Package prices built from scales, profiles, services and add-ons.

yenileme.aciklama: Track domain, hosting, SSL and subscription renewals in one list; reminders before expiry and one-click renewal invoices.

bilgi_bankasi.aciklama: FAQs and guides; related articles are suggested when you open a ticket.

gorevler.aciklama: Follow tasks, progress and milestones on your project, plus this month's revision usage.

geri_bildirim.aciklama: Report bugs, suggestions or questions with screenshots from anywhere in the panel and track their status.

duyurular.aciklama: Maintenance, feature and important status announcements from the agency; dismiss the ones you've read.

oneri_kutusu.aciklama: Send improvement ideas and vote anonymously on other clients' suggestions.

baglantilar.aciklama: The agency's Google accounts (Analytics 4, Search Console, YouTube): real data for the analytics dashboard.

crm.aciklama: The agency's sales pipeline: leads from requests, price quotes and embedded forms; kanban, scoring, reminders and conversion to clients.

zaman_takibi.aciklama: Time the team spends on your projects: timer, approved timesheets, billable hours and a time-spent summary on the project card.

proje_sablonlari.aciklama: Your project starts with a ready task plan and dated milestones; an accepted quote turns straight into a planned project.

dinamik_qr.aciklama: QR codes and short links whose destination you can change later: Google reviews, WhatsApp, vCard, Wi-Fi and more; logo and colours, bulk CSV, scan analytics.

dijital_kartvizit.ad: Digital business card and bio link
dijital_kartvizit.aciklama: A digital business card and bio link page shared from your phone: save contact, QR, WhatsApp/LinkedIn preview, contact form, password protection and visit analytics.

google_yorum_sayfasi.aciklama: A QR page for table cards or receipts: a large "Write a review on Google" button and an optional private feedback form; view and click analytics.

qr_menu.aciklama: A multilingual QR menu for restaurants and cafés: table QR codes, categories, items with options, allergens, cart, coupons and ordering via WhatsApp.

whatsapp_katalog.aciklama: A product showcase with shareable product pages; customers fill a cart and the order arrives as a WhatsApp message. No payment setup needed.

api_erisimi.aciklama: Connect your own software and automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n) to the portal: scoped, revocable API keys, signed webhook notifications and an MCP connection for AI assistants like Claude.

randevu.aciklama: A Calendly-style booking page: event types, weekly availability and exceptions, team (round-robin), conflict-free booking, .ics invites, reminder emails, cancel/reschedule links, calendar subscription and an embeddable widget for your site.

otomasyon.aciklama: "When this happens, do that": conditional email, panel notification, task, webhook and wait steps on events (tickets, invoices, tasks, bookings…); ready-made templates, dry runs and a 30-day run log.

ai_asistan.aciklama: A chat assistant that answers from your documents, site and FAQ and embeds on your website with one line: it cites sources, doesn't make things up, and hands visitors over to your team with a support ticket; conversation records, usage and credit tracking.

icerik_studyosu.aciklama: Brand voice profiles, 13 ready AI content templates (Instagram, Reels, LinkedIn, X thread, blog, newsletter, ads…) plus your own; character limit checks and warning badges; social media calendar, client approval, UTM short links, ready-to-share pack and CSV export.

eposta_pazarlama.aciklama: Newsletters, campaigns and drip sequences: double opt-in signup form, lists and segments, mobile-friendly emails with a block editor, test sends, scheduling, A/B subject tests, delivery reports, one-click unsubscribe and consent records.

saha_servisi.aciklama: For cleaning, HVAC, technical service and maintenance companies: work orders, a drag-and-drop dispatch board, a mobile technician screen (checklist, photos, customer signature, consent-based location), equipment history and maintenance reminders, a service report PDF and a signed status page for the customer.

etkinlik_bilet.aciklama: Registration pages for seminars, workshops, concerts, webinars and open days: ticket types (early bird, student, hidden), discount codes, quotas and a waiting list, QR tickets (PDF + calendar), door check-in with a phone camera, announcements and a post-event survey email.

stok_pos.aciklama: For cafés, boutiques, small shops and salons selling products: barcoded products and variants, stock per branch, stock in/out/count/transfer, low-stock alerts, a touch-friendly till, non-fiscal receipts, refunds, end-of-day report, profit and stock value reports; works with linked QR menu products.

egitim.aciklama: For course centres, tutoring schools, workshops and instructors: course page and registration form (with parent details), recurring class schedule, QR attendance, online lessons (video link, files, progress), quizzes and assignments, AI-drafted questions, conditional certificates and a verification page.

belgeler.aciklama: Your own documents, wiki and notes (to-dos, version history, PDF/Markdown) and strategy templates: SWOT, Business Model Canvas, Lean Canvas, PESTLE, Porter, McKinsey 7S, Blue Ocean, Ikigai; write, summarize, proofread and draft with AI.

insan_kaynaklari.aciklama: Staff records, leave requests and approval, annual leave balances (adjustable legal defaults), leave calendar, weekly shift plan and a no-login page for each employee. No payroll.

hukuk_burosu.aciklama: For lawyers and law offices: client and matter tracking, opposing parties with conflict-of-interest warnings, hearing and deadline calendar, deadline calculator, reminders, time and expense records (PDF statement), document attachments and a private status link for clients. Does not pull data from UYAP automatically.
